description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot application class 'Application' that sets up and deploys components related to Hono's Device Connection service using Vert.x verticles, with health check registration and dependency injection.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Main Spring Boot application class for deploying device connection verticles and managing health checks.

methods.name: setServiceImplementation
methods.description: Injects the device connection service implementation, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: setAuthenticationService
methods.description: Injects the authentication service, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: deployRequiredVerticles
methods.description: Deploys necessary verticles asynchronously, including service and auth verticles.

methods.name: deployVerticle
methods.description: Deploys a given verticle component and registers health checks if deployment is successful.

methods.name: postDeploy
methods.description: Registers health checks after deployment of a service instance.

methods.name: registerHealthCheckProvider
methods.description: Registers a health check provider if the object implements that interface.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method to start the Spring Boot application.
